esp32.detail: 8 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from CS to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from MOSI to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x1d. Added the adxl355.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the X, Y and Z acceleration and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes

Reports the X, Y and Z acceleration and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes
